_doc: DERIVED, not authored. Line geometry resampled by tools/smooth-lines.mjs; regenerate rather than hand-edit. Every vertex of the source survives at its own coordinate: the smoother interpolates, so no surveyed point is moved. Turns at or above the corner threshold are preserved exactly, because a right angle in a road or a cusp in a canyon is a fact and not a sampling artefact. MIXED COORDINATE PRECISION IS EXPECTED AND IS NOT A BUG: a feature this tool declined to touch, because its class is skipped or it has fewer than three points, is copied through verbatim and keeps the source precision, while a smoothed feature is written at method.coordinate_decimals. In atlas-routes that is 139 of 580 features.
